proposals.title: Visibility of battery level indicator
proposals.text: The battery level indicator must be visible on the instrument cluster after the charging port reaches the target charge (gear P).
proposals.rationale: Serves the implicit need “Know battery level and remaining charge time at a glance” and prevents uncertainty during the stop at the charger.

proposals.title: Battery level indicator remains visible during gear P
proposals.text: When the vehicle is in gear P (stop‑at‑charger), the battery level indicator must stay visible.
proposals.rationale: Adds a guard to the same implicit need, ensuring the information is not lost while the car is stationary.

proposals.title: Speed limit respected when Gear R is engaged
proposals.text: When the gear selector is set to R, the vehicle speed must not exceed 10 km/h.
proposals.rationale: Affects the “Only below 10 km/h” constraint for tight‑space maneuvers. Guarantees the safety rule that the game is intended for is respected.
